scope: Minor on 0.4.0: launch-readiness findings, accessibility scan (axe) and share-image check in check:quality, inline field errors, opening hours, consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2 and click-to-load embeds, a computed Content-Security-Policy for static builds, day-2 recipes, token tests that pass on initialised lanes, a replay control arm and the site:files adoption tool. One development dependency added (@axe-core/playwright 4.14.0); runtime dependencies (Astro 7.4.12, EmDash 1.5.0, adapters) and the database schema unchanged.

rerunAlone.note: every check passed; over the 60 s local budget (unit tests 44 s)

visual.result: 111 passed, 1 failed under load (gallery root typecheck child killed by its timeout: exit null), passed alone in 15.4 s; run with the visual harness fix of PR 108 (the stage did not copy scripts/static-csp.mjs, so the first run failed in setup) on top of the certified commit

findings: The visual suite failed in setup on the certified commit: tests/visual/site.mjs staged a fixed file list without scripts/static-csp.mjs, which the features integration now imports. Fixed in PR 108 (the stage copies every module the config reaches); check:dev-tools already did this and passed.

Workflow replay fixtures had stopped building since the RSS guard required SITE_URL, and two token tests failed on any site initialised with design:tokens --init-client; both fixed before certification (PR 104).
site:files planning on real sites found order-dependent blocking and imports read from comments and test strings; fixed after certification in a maintainer-only tool that is not distributed (PR 107).

check:ci-fast passed every check on both Node versions but exceeded its 60 s local budget: the first runs shared the machine with site staging (81 s and 66 s); run alone, Node 24.22.3 took 60 s (pass) and Node 22.23.4 65 s (unit tests 44 s). The new site-files unit test (about 8 s of Git history lookups) is the largest addition; moving it out of the fast tier is a follow-up.

sync:baseline reads a JSDoc import() type as a missing local import, so a static site sees a false migration reason on scripts/baseline-features-integration.mjs; left for the next patch because the helper is pinned.
